cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our invisible dinner guest is here. Introduce Mum while I finish the gravy. I didn't spend all those afternoons practising introductions for you to hide in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The chair beside you. Name first, then something they share—just as I showed you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To the person, love, not the chair. You got past this with the twins. Fetch Mum another seat; we don't make a guest stand because they're hard to see.
